subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Grafar palavras utilizando regras de correspondência fonema-grafema regulares, contextuais e morfológicas e palavras de uso frequente com correspondências irregulares.

components.description_pt: Aplicar regras de correspondência fonema-grafema regulares para soletrar palavras corretamente
components.description_en: Apply regular phoneme-grapheme correspondence rules to spell words correctly
components.cc_component_description: Apply spelling rules and patterns to spell unfamiliar words accurately

components.description_pt: Aplicar regras de ortografia contextual para escrever palavras com correspondências dependentes de contexto
components.description_en: Apply contextual spelling rules to write words with context-dependent correspondences
components.cc_component_description: Apply position-based spelling rules when writing words in context

components.description_pt: Aplicar regras morfológicas para soletrar palavras com padrões morfológicos previsíveis
components.description_en: Apply morphological rules to spell words with predictable morphological patterns
components.cc_component_description: Use meaningful word parts including roots and affixes to spell unfamiliar words

components.description_pt: Soletrar palavras irregulares frequentes utilizando ortografia convencional
components.description_en: Spell frequently occurring irregular words using conventional spelling
components.cc_component_description: Spell frequently occurring irregular words using conventional spelling

cc_matches.description: Use spelling patterns and generalizations (e.g., word families, position-based spellings, syllable patterns, ending rules, meaningful word parts) in writing words.
Use conventional spelling for words with common spelling patterns and for frequently occurring irregular words.
